name: pr-writer
description: Writes pull request descriptions from commit history and diff summary. Produces structured markdown.

inputs.name: Commits
inputs.description: List of commits in the PR (git log output)

inputs.name: Diff Summary
inputs.description: Summary of changes (git diff --stat or condensed diff)

inputs.name: Branch Name
inputs.description: Branch name (used to infer PR purpose)

config.template:
Write a pull request description. Output ONLY the markdown content.

## Branch
{{branchName}}

## Commits
{{commits}}

## Changes Summary
{{diffSummary}}

## Context
{{context}}

## Output Format
## Summary
[1-3 bullet points explaining WHAT changed and WHY]

## Changes
[List of specific changes grouped by area]

## Test Plan
[How to verify the changes work]

## Example
## Summary
- Add email validation to user registration form
- Prevents invalid emails from reaching the backend

## Changes
- **frontend/src/components/RegisterForm.tsx**: Added email regex validation
- **frontend/src/utils/validators.ts**: New `isValidEmail()` utility

## Test Plan
- [ ] Enter invalid email → see error message
- [ ] Enter valid email → form submits successfully

Now write the PR description:
